details: Issue #223 Quote Management Vertical Slice fully implemented. All 65 tests pass (30 route integration + 35 validation schema). Backend: 7 API endpoints with draft-only enforcement (403), line item CRUD, snapshotted pricing in integer cents. Frontend: QuotesPage list view with status filter, CreateQuoteForm dialog with customer selection, QuoteDetailPanel with editable line items table and stock warnings. Line item types: part, labor, bicycle all supported.
findings: Draft-only enforcement verified across all 6 mutation endpoints (PATCH/DELETE on quotes + POST/PATCH/DELETE on line items)
Snapshotted prices stored at line creation time — unitPriceNet and vatRateId never re-fetched
All amounts use integer cents internally, displayed via formatCentsToEuro() from shared utils
Per-line discount in basis points (nullable), total-level discount computed client-side only for this slice
Raw SQL used for quote_line_items inserts/updates due to Drizzle ORM issues with spread columns
